scenes.headline: How DCFormer lets attention heads borrow each other's work
scenes.sub: Dynamically composable multi-head attention, an ICML 2024 oral
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pudding! Attention heads normally work alone. DCFormer lets them mix, token by token. Here's how, and what it buys.

scenes.text: Don't make heads wider. Let them compose: recombine every head's attention scores and weights per token, with mixing weights computed from the query and key.
scenes.say: The idea: don't make heads wider. Let them compose, recombining every head's scores and weights per token, mixed by the query and key.

steps.say: Each head computes its query-key scores, as usual.
The first Compose mixes those scores across heads, before the softmax.
The second mixes the attention weights, after it.
Then values are weighted and heads merged, as usual. The number of key-value heads is unchanged.

scenes.title: Which heads each head can read

steps.label: Multi-head attention: each head alone
steps.say: In plain attention, each head keeps its own scores. Heads never see each other's work, so they can duplicate it.

steps.label: Compose: every head from every head
steps.say: Compose lets each head draw on every other head's scores and weights. One fixed mix like this is Talking-Heads attention.

scenes.title: Inside Compose
scenes.say: Stack every head's score into a vector. Compose sums five branches.

parts.note: branch one: in practice, a plain skip connection
parts.say: Branch one is, in practice, a plain skip connection.

parts.note: a low-rank projection and a gate, made from the query
parts.say: Two and three: a low-rank projection and a gate, generated from the query.

parts.note: the same pair, made from the key
parts.say: Four and five: the same pair, generated from the key.

scenes.title: Why the mix must be dynamic
scenes.note: Pile validation perplexity in the ablation, lower is better
scenes.say: A fixed mix provably equals a wider head. In the ablation, that takes perplexity to eleven point one seven. Dynamic Compose reaches ten point seven nine.

scenes.label: Pile perplexity for DCPythia-6.9B, ahead of Pythia-12B at 6.01
scenes.note: about 1.3% extra parameters at the 6.9B scale
scenes.say: At scale, the six point nine B version reaches five point nine five, ahead of Pythia twelve B, for about one point three percent more parameters.

scenes.text: Heads that borrow each other's circuits per token get more than wider heads would, for about 1.3% more parameters.
scenes.mark: borrow each other's circuits per token

recap: Compose mixes heads' scores and weights, per token
Five branches, made from the query and key
It must be trained from scratch
scenes.say: To recap: two Compose calls, five branches from the query and key, and heads that share work.
